environment.description: Deployed in a containerized environment connecting to PostgreSQL 15.4 via pg_bouncer (transaction pooling mode). The database connection string uses role 'report_reader' which was provisioned with a restricted grant set. The PostgreSQL pg_hba.conf enforces md5 auth for this role from the container subnet only. The role's privileges were configured via: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO report_reader; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO report_reader; No additional GRANT statements exist for this role. The role has NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOINHERIT attributes. A row-level security policy is NOT enabled (tables use standard permission checks only). The container runs with a read-only root filesystem (--read-only flag) with a tmpfs mount at /tmp limited to 10MB. The container's seccomp profile is the default Docker profile. Note: the pg_bouncer pool_mode=transaction means SET ROLE commands issued by the application are reset between transactions.

config.db_grants: SELECT only on public schema tables
config.pg_hba: md5 auth from container subnet 10.0.3.0/24 only
